messages:
alex: Quick sync request — we have two pilot customers ready for Dedicated. Need to lock onboarding checklist for burst credits + SLAs. Can we decide launch gates today?

mira: +1. Main asks are guaranteed baseline + burst pool and clear failure modes. Customers want a contractual burst budget for day 1.

samir: We should avoid hard promises on absolute latency for burst. Propose: baseline reserved throughput (committed qps) + burst credits with soft SLO (p90). If we hit capacity, fallback to cheaper model variant + degrade gracefully.

jen: Agree on graceful fallback. Also need ops runbook for manual escalation and an alerting page for burst exhaustion. Who owns the runbook?

kai: I can own the runbook. Draft outline: onboarding checklist, initial quota mapping, burst allocation logic, alert thresholds, escalation matrix, rollback steps.

alex: Nice. For launch criteria I propose minimal set: 1) Can allocate per-tenant reserved baseline, 2) Configurable burst pool assignment, 3) Observability: per-tenant burst usage + 1h/24h peak charts, 4) Runbook + SLO doc signed off, 5) Two pilot customers validated. Thoughts?

mira: Add automated tests for preemption behavior (simulate heavy traffic + confirm fallback). Also require billing flagging when burst consumption > commit by 50%.

samir: On the quota model: recommend buckets with time-decay credits (e.g., credits replenish at X/min). Also support manual top-ups for enterprise customers. Pseudocode we used in previous RFC: 
```
# simple replenish model
replenish_rate = committed_qps * 60  # tokens per minute
max_burst = committed_qps * burst_multiplier
```
Keep it flexible in config.

jen: For contractual language, legal wants an explicit definition of "burst" (tokens/min or concurrent units) and observable metric to measure it. We should define a single canonical metric.

kai: Propose metric name: `dedicated.burst_tokens_used_per_minute` and `dedicated.baseline_qps`. Use those in SLAs and alerts.

capacity-bot: deploy: staging/dedicated-burst-sim v0.3 finished — load test results uploaded: https://ci.internal/reports/1769

alex: Excellent — can someone own final launch checklist and sign-off? I can coordinate stakeholders but need product + eng + legal owners.

mira: I'll own product sign-off. Will prepare a 1-pager mapping features to launch gates.

samir: Engineering sign-off from me after we add preemption tests and the configurable replenish model. ETA EOD tomorrow for tests.

jen: Legal: I will draft the burst clause template and circulate by Friday.

alex: Action items: @mira 1-pager, @samir tests + config, @kai runbook draft, @jen legal clause. Let's aim to have pilot onboarding checklist complete before the next pilot kickoff (2 weeks). :thumbsup:

mira: noted. I'll drop the doc into product/launch folder and ping everyone for review.

samir: Will link test results in the thread when ready.

kai: Runbook draft in ~48h, will include example alert rules and escalation play.

jen: Circulating legal language Fri. If any customer wants custom burst guarantees we should treat that as enterprise negotiation (SOW).

alex: Cool — thanks all. If anything blocks the tests or runbook call it out here.

capacity-bot: reminder: next pilot kickoff scheduled in 13 days — please have artifacts ready for customer demo.
